my-nonstop-chatter-unlocked-autistic-ste.copied_text: Eight-year-old Clara never stops talking, but in her new stepfamily's silent mansion, her chatter is treated like a curse. Four-year-old Tommy, her autistic stepbrother, hasn't spoken in two years—until Clara's gentle stories reach him. As Tommy slowly finds his voice, Clara must challenge a family that mistakes silence for safety and prove that sometimes, being heard begins with someone willing to keep talking.
